title: The coefficient unit is finite Tor constructible
statement: For the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions], a scheme $Y$ with a structure morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $e\mid n$, the intrinsic realization [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] of $A_Y[0]$ belongs to $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. No finite-type or separatedness hypothesis on $Y$ is required.

source.place: first paragraph, tensor-unit argument proving constructibility and Tor amplitude

proof.text: For an abstract finite commutative coefficient ring, identify the constant rank-one sheaf with the sheaf tensor unit by the monoidal sheafification unit. Its degree-zero single complex has constructible cohomology: the unit in degree zero and zero in all other degrees. The derived single-unit isomorphism and the derived tensor left unitor show that tensoring any degree-zero module with it remains in degree zero.

The coefficient prime is invertible on every residue field, by the structure map to the fixed field. Apply finiteCoefficient_comparison_preserves_torAmplitude with interval [0,0]. The exact-functor composition and single-complex comparisons identify this image with the stated intrinsic realization. Transport bounded constructibility and finite Tor amplitude through that isomorphism.
